dialogue.text: Jụrụ na m kwuo okwuu ndị a n'ụzọ nke ọma. Anyị ga-eme ka ị dị n'ime ndụ anyị.
dialogue.translation: Discuss what I say in the right way. We will act so it exists in our lives.

key_phrases.phrase: Biko, gbaara anyị ka anyị kwuo ngwa ngwa n'okwuu ndị a ...
key_phrases.translation: Please, let's challenge ourselves to speak openly about these words ...

key_phrases.phrase: Zuzu ndụ anyị dị n'okpuru ndụ nke ụwa ndọrọ ndọrọ ndụ.
key_phrases.translation: Shaped by our lives under globalized existence.

key_phrases.phrase: Nọm n'ime nche a pụọ!
key_phrases.translation: Stay away from this doubt!
